_doc: Module 6 worked examples. The good call reads the job aid's KYC line as written; the contrast call shows a rep improvising on PSD2 and SCA. Anonymised first names only.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Before I sign anything — how long does signup take? My bookkeeper hates paperwork.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: We run KYC at signup, and it takes the owner about 10 minutes. The process is smoother than your bank's.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Ten minutes for the owner. Your bookkeeper doesn't have to touch it.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: OK. Send me a calendar invite for next Tuesday, 11 — I'll do it then.

transcripts.outcome: trust damaged · buyer escalated to procurement

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Are you PSD2 compliant? And how do you handle SCA delegation for our AWS and SaaS subscriptions?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Yeah, we're fully PSD2 — and on SCA delegation, I think we use a step-up flow that, uh, depends on the merchant... I'm pretty sure it's fine for AWS.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: You think? You're pretty sure? That's not an answer I can put in a memo.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Right, no — what I meant was, the platform handles it. Like, technically, the rails do all of it for you.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Listen — get me someone who actually knows the regulation. I'll loop in procurement; this isn't a sales conversation anymore.
